scope: Product config editor save, backup, explicit standard restart and repair. Desktop simulated MCU only; full Moonraker and physical acceptance remain pending.

implementation.processEntry: createNativeProductHostFactory with createProcess and configFiles.writable relative allowlist
implementation.save: POST /server/files/upload root=config; optional If-Match previous ETag; optional submitted-content checksum
implementation.controlled: POST /printer/host/config/save or printer.host.config.save: version=1, path, UTF-8 content, expected_sha256
implementation.response: Multipart top-level item/action for fixed clients; existing result alias retained for native callers
implementation.concurrency: One active save including actual authorization settlement; immutable input copy; current device gate held through transaction; stale generation rejected; confirmed detached failed startup can be repaired
protection: Print, pause, pending device work, unconfirmed stop, reload and shutdown reject writes.
Pinned parent descriptors, no path traversal, symlink or reserved source; only explicit existing files.
NUL/invalid UTF-8 rejected; invalid textual config allowed for explicit failure-and-repair workflow.
transaction: Temporary replacement preserves source mode/owner; file and parent directory sync before replace
Revalidate source inode, size, times, mode and owner immediately before atomic rename
Sync directory after replacement; replaced phase uncertainty never reports success
Cleanup checks ownership; final close waits actual work; standard file change notification only on success
implementation.backupLimit: 16 copies per file; no automatic deletion. Product backup retention/manage/restore remain pending.
implementation.restart: RESTART and FIRMWARE_RESTART script-only compatibility delegates to existing standard host control, durable response handoff and receipts; arbitrary script remains rejected.

source.command: node --test --test-isolation=none host/test/native-config-save.test.ts host/test/native-config-files.test.ts host/test/native-product-bootstrap.test.ts host/test/native-product-process-lifetime.test.ts host/test/product-host-control.test.ts host/test/product-host-api.test.ts host/test/native-print-uploads.test.ts host/test/native-request-scope.test.ts host/test/configured-server.test.ts
checks: Fault injection at each file/directory sync phase; source unchanged before rename, uncertain replaced phase retains exact backup.
External source mutation during transaction causes conflict without overwrite.
Existing source/include reads, auth, reservations and current gcodes upload retained.
First startup failure repair through actual HTTP save, standard script restart and same MCU ownership.
Unconfirmed cleanup and stop refuse config writes.
Initial config byte and exact listing/stat persistence through normal/FW/independent process recovery.
Same compiled artifact and original MCU; JWT/files/history retained; no print replay.
If-Match multipart save, exact original backup download, standard RESTART script and saved bytes after reload.
Concurrent auth/upload/status/subscription/history and config list/download while simulated printing
Config save attempt rejected while actual active print state
Minimum step lead > 0; loop P99 < 50 ms and max < 100 ms
compiledLoad.interpretation: Desktop timing observations, no target-board budget or matched Python comparison.

diagnosticFindings.resolution: Top-level upload fields exposed and original native result alias retained; actual page rerun passed.

diagnosticFindings.resolution: Corrected fixture contract to rw; final affected load rerun passed.

diagnosticFindings.resolution: Test now lets FormData create its multipart Content-Type; both final mode reruns passed.
